sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 14.6 grams of fat. Saturated fat is 0.6 grams, supporting a cleaner fat profile. Polyunsaturated fat is 3.3 grams, not adding much useful unsaturated fat, so that's a real downside for seeds. For seeds, fat quality is a big reason to use them.
